Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 2
, Reason for Mistake: In Step 2, the Planner incorrectly concluded that Caligula's mother was "Agrippina the Younger" based on the visible text on the Caligula Wikipedia page. The text explicitly states Caligula was the son of "Augustus' granddaughter Agrippina the Elder". The Planner confused the two distinct historical figures (Agrippina the Elder vs. Agrippina the Younger) and misidentified the mother-in-law as Agrippina the Younger in subsequent steps.
